content: The following text is a detailed list of contributors and their affiliations, as well as specific editorial changes to the guidelines for drinking-water quality. Editorial Changes to the Guidelines: The page headers on pages 511, 513, 515, and 517 are to be updated to read: ANNEX 7. CONTRIBUTORS TO FOURTH EDITION INCORPORATING FIRST ADDENDUM. On page 518, under the section Page numbers in bold indicate main discussions, a note is to be added stating: This index has not been updated to reflect any new entries or changes that result from the incorporation of the first addendum into the fourth edition of the Guidelines.
